title_en: The Conditions under Which Zakat Becomes Obligatory
body_ar: السلام عليكم و رحمة الله و بركاته لوجوب الزكاة ثلاثة شروط: تمام النصاب وتمام الملك و تمام الحول و النصاب من العملات ثمن ٨٤ غراما من الذهب من أقل عيار ثمنا و ذلك الآن من الأوقية مليون و مائتا ألف و تمام الملك مخرج للدين الذين سيقضى في الحول بخلاف ما يتأخر عن ذلك من الأقساط أو الديون المؤجلة و الدين التجاري الحال ينزع من رأس مال الشركة لأنها شخصية اعتبارية و الديون التي لمالك النصاب تنقسم إلى ثلاثة أقسام إلى : ضمار و هو الميئوس منه فلا يزكى و إن قدر الحصول عليه استؤنف به ، و ظَّنون و هو المحتمل فيقوم بحسب الحلول و اليسار و الإقرار و أضدادها، و مقطوع به و هو الدين الحال على موسر مقر حاضر لا يستحيي من طلبه كديون بعض التجار على بعض فيزكى كله . و تمام الحول إنما يعتبر في النقود من يوم تمام النصاب بالسنة القمرية . و عليه فإن الراتب إذا كمل منه في حساب الإنسان نصاب بعد ما يقتطع منه من الضرائب و التأمين فحال عليه الحول لم ينقص عن النصاب في أي وقت فتجب حينئذ زكاته بإخراج اثنين و نصف بالمائة من الموجود سواء كان من عملة واحدة أو لا في حساب واحد أو لا في بلد واحد أو لا و العبرة بالعملة التي تصل إلى يد الإنسان و قيمة العملة تعرف بغالب تعامل الناس و لا شك أن السوق السوداء في بلادنا غالبة على التعامل و الله أعلم
body_en:
Peace be upon you, and the mercy of God and His blessings.

For zakat to be obligatory there are three conditions: completion of the minimum threshold (niṣāb), completion of ownership, and completion of the lunar year of possession (ḥawl).

The threshold in the case of currencies is the price of 84 grams of gold of the carat lowest in price; and that at present, in ouguiya, is one million two hundred thousand.

Completion of ownership excludes the debt that will be discharged within the year, as against what falls due later than that among instalments or deferred debts. A commercial debt presently due is deducted from the company's capital, because the company is a juristic person.

The debts owed to the holder of the threshold fall into three classes. The first is ḍimār, the debt despaired of: no zakat is paid on it, and if it does become possible to obtain it, a fresh year is begun with it. The second is ẓanūn, the doubtful debt: it is assessed according to whether it has fallen due, whether the debtor is solvent, whether he acknowledges it, and the opposites of these. The third is the debt held as certain: the debt presently due upon a solvent debtor who acknowledges it, who is at hand, and from whom one is not too embarrassed to ask for it — as with the debts some traders hold against others. Zakat is paid on the whole of it.

Completion of the year, in the case of money, is reckoned only from the day the threshold is complete, by the lunar year.

Accordingly, if a salary accumulates in a person's account to the amount of a threshold — after what is deducted from it in taxes and insurance — and a year passes over it without its falling below the threshold at any point, then its zakat becomes obligatory at that time, by paying out two and a half per cent of what is there: whether it is in one currency or not, in one account or not, in one country or not. What counts is the currency that reaches the person's hand, and the value of the currency is known by the dealing that prevails among people — and there is no doubt that in our country the black market prevails in dealings. And God knows best.

flags.context: ضمار و هو الميئوس منه فلا يزكى و إن قدر الحصول عليه استؤنف به
flags.note: Technical term of the zakat chapter, not in the project glossary and a candidate for addition. Kept transliterated with the Sheikh's own gloss beside it, because the three-way classification ḍimār / ẓanūn / certain is what the passage is for and flattening the terms into ordinary English loses the scheme.

flags.context: و ظَّنون و هو المحتمل فيقوم بحسب الحلول و اليسار و الإقرار و أضدادها
flags.note: As with ḍimār: a term of art, kept transliterated with the Sheikh's gloss. The source vowels it with a shadda on the ẓāʾ, which is not the standard form (ظَنُون); preserved as written per house rule 11. Candidate for the glossary.

flags.arabic: ثمن ٨٤ غراما من الذهب … و ذلك الآن من الأوقية مليون و مائتا ألف
options: reproduce the figure as given, with a note that it is the price of a date and a currency
convert the figure to current values
flags.note: CRITICAL FOR DISPLAY. The figure is a price in Mauritanian ouguiya as at the CMS date of January 2016, and it is stated as 'at present'. Mauritania redenominated the ouguiya in 2018 at ten old to one new, so the number is wrong twice over for any reader today: once for gold's movement and once for the currency. It must not be presented as a live threshold. Note also that the Sheikh gives 84 grams, where the more commonly cited Maliki figure for twenty dinars is about 85; reproduced as he gives it and not adjusted.

flags.context: ثمن ٨٤ غراما من الذهب من أقل عيار ثمنا
options: the lowest grade of gold by value
flags.note: The rule matters in practice, since it sets the threshold at its lowest and so brings more payers within zakat. Rendered literally. It is not qualified in the text by any statement of which carat is meant in his market.

flags.arabic: و لا شك أن السوق السوداء في بلادنا غالبة على التعامل
flags.context: the closing sentence on how a currency is valued
options: render it as a general principle without the local observation
flags.note: EDITORIAL. The sentence is a statement of fact about Mauritania's currency market, made in passing to settle which exchange rate to value a holding at. Translated exactly as given, neither softened nor dropped. Publication in English of a scholar's statement that the parallel market prevails over the official one is a decision for Ummah Collective and the Sheikh's office.

translator_notes: This is a compressed technical answer and the English keeps its order: the three conditions, then the threshold, then what completion of ownership excludes, then the classification of debts owed to the payer, then how the year is reckoned, then the worked application to a salaried person.
The scope of the answer is money and salary. It says nothing about zakat on trade goods, livestock or crops, and nothing has been supplied for them.
شخصية اعتبارية rendered 'juristic person'. The Sheikh uses the modern legal category to justify deducting the company's own due debts from its capital rather than from the shareholder's wealth.
The CMS date of 4 January 2016 is an upload date. It is nonetheless the only date attached to the ouguiya figure, which is why the figure cannot be read without it.
استؤنف به rendered 'a fresh year is begun with it': the recovered debt starts its own ḥawl rather than joining the existing one.
